_comment: Every surface that must mirror the house-skills source of truth. `source` is optional and defaults to this repo's own skills/ dir, which is what makes a fresh clone work with no local config; set it only to point at a checkout elsewhere, and never commit an absolute path that only exists on one machine. `surfaces` is the list of local mounts to check file by file. estate_diff.py discovers skills by scanning source, so new skills are covered automatically. `path` supports ~ expansion. `kind` is dir for a local mount, cloud for a tier reachable only through a web UI.
_governed_surfaces: Six: Claude Code, Claude.ai, Cowork, ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API. Two of them mount locally and are diffed file by file. The other four are reached through a web UI or an upload endpoint that this toolchain cannot read, so they are tracked as publication records instead.

surfaces.name: claude-code
surfaces.note: Installed from source by install.sh --platform claude.

surfaces.name: codex
surfaces.note: Installed from source by install.sh --platform codex. The open SKILL.md package format.

_cloud_comment: These four cannot be read from here: publishing is a human step through a web UI or an upload endpoint, and this toolchain holds no credential for any of them. They are tracked by ledger instead. build_bundles.py hashes every bundle it writes; record_publish.py stamps those hashes against a surface once a human has published them. estate_diff.py then reports how many bundles each tier is behind. A ledger row is a publication record, not verification. It says what was last published, which is the difference between a known gap and an invisible one.

cloud_surfaces.name: claude.ai-org
cloud_surfaces.note: Aleysian organization tier. Upload dist/*.skill through claude.ai settings. Needs org admin.

cloud_surfaces.name: chatgpt
cloud_surfaces.note: ChatGPT skill surface. Same bundles, uploaded through the ChatGPT UI.

cloud_surfaces.name: openai-api
cloud_surfaces.note: Skills attached to an OpenAI API deployment. Published by whoever owns that deployment, so a record here is the only visibility this repo has.

_optional_surfaces.name: claude.ai-offline
_optional_surfaces.note: point at an offline export of the claude.ai bundle to diff the cloud tier file by file instead of by ledger
